entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: Ancient demonic shapeshifter planeswalker who seeks to control powerful beings.

entities.name: Dakkon
entities.description: Planeswalker corrupted by Dihada who forged the Blackblade.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Weapon forged by Dakkon for Dihada, which absorbed his shadow and soul.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar
entities.description: Maro-Sorcerer and nature spirit of Khone corrupted by Dihada into a demon king.

entities.name: Piru
entities.description: Elder Dragon bound by Dihada and killed by Dakkon.

entities.name: Rhuell
entities.description: Elder Dragon summoned by Dihada to fight Dakkon.

entities.name: Carth
aliases: boy named for the kingdom of Carth
entities.description: Boy tricked by Dihada into summoning Dakkon.

entities.name: Unholy Citadel
entities.description: Walking fortress made from slain enemies.

entities.name: Blackblade-Dihada War
entities.description: Brief battles between Dakkon and Dihada.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy at Lat-Nam taken over by Dihada.

events.summary: Dihada has Dakkon forge the Blackblade, then triggers his spark and absorbs his soul into it.
events.quote: but then she used the Blackblade to absorb his shadow and his soul into the blade.

events.summary: Dihada corrupts Sol'Kanar and sets about conquering Corondor.
Dihada tricks a boy into summoning and binding Dakkon, robbing him of planeswalking.
events.quote: This effectively robbed Dakkon of his planeswalking ability

events.summary: Dakkon kills Piru in a blast that creates the Dueling Chasm; Dihada absorbs the dragon's power and marks Dakkon.
events.quote: Dakkon killed Piru in a blast so powerful that it ripped the group apart

events.summary: Dihada leaves Dominaria and reappears at the Planeswalkers' War.
Dihada takes over the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam and Corondor.
events.quote: At some point, she disposed of the Academy's archmage and took his place.
